{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01Q9zkPwrxzMN6mTb4A3ki77","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Lrx6RfndQYQBtzaTc1foez","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/test_run.py","content":"import asyncio\nimport os\nimport signal\nimport sys\nimport time\n\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/app\")\nfrom run import run_tasks\n\n\nasync def test_basic():\n    \"\"\"All tasks run; no more than max_concurrent at once.\"\"\"\n    in_flight = 0\n    peak = 0\n    completed = []\n\n    def make_task(i):\n        async def task():\n            nonlocal in_flight, peak\n            in_flight += 1\n            peak = max(peak, in_flight)\n            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)\n            in_flight -= 1\n            completed.append(i)\n        return task\n\n    await run_tasks([make_task(i) for i in range(10)], max_concurrent=3)\n    assert sorted(completed) == list(range(10)), completed\n    assert peak == 3, peak\n    print(f\"test_basic OK (peak={peak}, completed={sorted(completed)})\")\n\n\nasync def test_cleanup_on_cancel():\n    \"\"\"When the outer call is cancelled, started tasks get to run their finally blocks.\"\"\"\n    cleaned = []\n    started = []\n\n    def make_task(i):\n        async def task():\n            started.append(i)\n            try:\n                await asyncio.sleep(10)\n            finally:\n                cleaned.append(i)\n        return task\n\n    outer = asyncio.create_task(\n        run_tasks([make_task(i) for i in range(5)], max_concurrent=2)\n    )\n    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)  # let two tasks start\n    outer.cancel()\n    try:\n        await outer\n    except asyncio.CancelledError:\n        pass\n    # Only tasks that actually started should have cleanup; both started ones must clean up.\n    assert set(cleaned) == set(started), (cleaned, started)\n    assert len(started) == 2, started\n    print(f\"test_cleanup_on_cancel OK (started={started}, cleaned={cleaned})\")\n\n\nasync def test_propagates_exception():\n    \"\"\"If a task raises, the exception propagates and the rest get cancelled+cleaned.\"\"\"\n    cleaned = []\n\n    async def boom():\n        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)\n        raise RuntimeError(\"boom\")\n\n    async def long():\n        try:\n            await asyncio.sleep(10)\n        finally:\n            cleaned.append(\"long\")\n\n    try:\n        await run_tasks([boom, long], max_concurrent=2)\n    except RuntimeError as e:\n        assert str(e) == \"boom\"\n    assert cleaned == [\"long\"], cleaned\n    print(f\"test_propagates_exception OK (cleaned={cleaned})\")\n\n\nasync def main():\n    await test_basic()\n    await test_cleanup_on_cancel()\n    await test_propagates_exception()\n\n\nasyncio.run(main())\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":367,"cache_read_input_tokens":27793,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":367,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"20942fc9-55b5-4f2e-a58c-7610b71b46d2","uuid":"1b93a256-f455-42b5-a413-cc156f07c283","request_id":"req_011Cb3jp7qTv2opm3UTEhRB1"}
